$comment: HYD-3601 Francis turbine-generator unit twin. Expected efficiency from the hill chart at the measured unit speed and unit flow, expected head loss from Darcy-Weisbach, plant sigma from the tailwater level; the unit sends only what it measures.

identification.manufacturer: Custom-built vertical Francis unit (hydro units are designed per site: no public data sheet)
identification.model: Hill chart shape anchored on the public NTNU Francis-99 model turbine; prototype size is an assumption
identification.description: Unit 1 of a high-head storage hydro plant: vertical Francis turbine, 22-pole synchronous generator, digital governor, penstock
identification.turbine: Vertical-shaft Francis turbine, spiral case, 14 stay vanes, 28 guide vanes, runner 1.8 m (outlet), elbow draft tube
identification.generator: Synchronous generator, 22 poles, 50 Hz (272.7 rpm), umbrella type: thrust bearing below the rotor
identification.governor: Digital PID governor with an oil pressure unit (OPU) and two guide vane servomotors
identification.waterway: Intake with trash rack, steel penstock 900 m long, 3.2 m diameter, main inlet valve
identification.site: A storage hydro plant in a river valley (generic)

hill_chart.source: NTNU Francis-99 model turbine (Waterpower Laboratory, NTNU), workshop data: peak model efficiency 93.4 % at nED = 0.18 and QED = 0.20 (BEP), reference diameter 0.349 m. Prototype peak = model peak + step-up (IEC 60193 gives step-up formulas): assumption: typical value, replace with your contract step-up. Ellipse coefficients of the iso-efficiency curves eta = eta_max - a (dq)^2 - b (dn)^2 with dq = QED/QED_bep - 1 - tilt x dn, dn = nED/nED_bep - 1: assumption: typical value, replace with the prototype hill chart from your model acceptance test (IEC 60193)

unit.source: Runner reference (outlet) diameter, poles and generator efficiency: assumption: typical value, replace with your unit's data. Synchronous speed n = 120 f / poles = 272.73 rpm. Guide vane opening at the BEP: assumption: typical value, replace with the model test

levels.source: Reservoir and tailwater levels (m above sea level), runner reference elevation (8 m below normal tailwater) and spiral case inlet pressure tap elevation: assumption: typical value, replace with the plant's level survey

waterway.source: Penstock length, diameter and Darcy friction factor (welded steel), minor loss coefficients of intake, trash rack, bends and inlet valve, spiral inlet diameter and draft tube outlet area: assumption: typical value, replace with the waterway design report or a measured head loss curve

flow.source: Winter-Kennedy coefficient k in Q = k sqrt(dp), dp in kPa, Q in m3/s (exponent 0.5): assumption: typical value, replace with the calibration against an absolute flow measurement (IEC 60041 index test)

cavitation.source: Required Thoma number from the model test, with its safety margin, as sigma_bep x (1 + 1.5 x overload + 0.3 x part load) in q = QED/QED_bep: assumption: typical value, replace with the sigma curves of your model acceptance test. Barometer about 98.9 kPa at a site about 200 m above sea level

draft_tube.source: Draft tube cone pressure pulsation, peak-to-peak in % of the net head: a base level plus a part-load vortex rope peak around q = 0.6. assumption: typical value, replace with the model test or a commissioning sweep of your unit. Vortex rope precession frequency 0.3 x runner frequency, inside the 0.2 to 0.4 band reported in the literature

bearings.source: Turbine guide bearing (TGB) oil = cooling water + a0 + a1 L; TGB pad = TGB oil + b0 + b1 L; thrust pad = cooling water + c0 + c1 L (L = P / rated). Shaft runout = r0 + r1 x draft tube pulsation. assumption: typical value, replace with a least-squares fit on a few months of healthy data of this unit

governor.source: Oil pressure unit working pressure: assumption: typical value, replace with the governor data sheet

demo.note: Demo only: one real second is one plant minute; one record every 10 real seconds. Dispatch moves the load slowly between 45 and 60 MW; the rough zone failure mode holds the unit at 30 MW.

groups.Flow: Winter-Kennedy taps on the spiral case
groups.Governor: Guide vanes and oil pressure unit

points.label: Headwater level at the intake (upstream of the trash rack)
Guide vane opening setpoint from the governor
Draft tube cone pressure pulsation, peak-to-peak in % of net head
Bearing cooling water flow, % of design
Relative shaft displacement at the turbine guide bearing, peak-to-peak

limits.source: Alarm limits: assumption: typical value, replace with your unit's commissioning values and the bearing maker's pad temperature limits. The shaft runout limit stands for the zone boundary of ISO 20816-5 for this machine type and bearing position (read the value from the standard; its zones are for evaluation, not early diagnosis).

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

runner_wear.name: Runner wear (cavitation erosion, sand abrasion, seal ring wear)
runner_wear.symptoms: efficiency below the hill chart at the same nED and QED, more flow (more gate) for the same power, lost MW

guide_vane_leakage.name: Guide vane wear and leakage (end and facing plate clearances)
guide_vane_leakage.symptoms: more flow than the gate opening explains, efficiency slightly lower, leakage at standstill

governor_servo_fault.name: Governor servomotor or oil pressure unit fault
governor_servo_fault.symptoms: guide vane position lags the governor setpoint, oil pressure unit pressure low

low_tailwater.name: Low tailwater: operation with too little submergence (cavitation risk)
low_tailwater.symptoms: tailwater falls, plant sigma drops below the sigma the runner needs at this load

rough_zone_operation.name: Operation in the part-load rough zone (draft tube vortex rope)
rough_zone_operation.symptoms: unit held at about half load, draft tube pressure pulsation high at 0.3 x runner frequency

guide_bearing_wear.name: Turbine guide bearing wear (clearance, pad damage)
guide_bearing_wear.symptoms: TGB pad hotter than its oil and load explain, shaft runout grows, oil normal

bearing_cooling_loss.name: Bearing cooling water loss (strainer blocked, valve closed)
bearing_cooling_loss.symptoms: cooling water flow low, every bearing oil and pad hotter together, pad-to-oil residual normal

intake_head_loss.name: Trash rack clogging or penstock fouling
intake_head_loss.symptoms: head loss from the intake to the spiral case above Darcy-Weisbach, net head and power down
